svg.text: Map interaction — drawing, picking, placing (house style; real FontAwesome glyphs; design §2.5 / §2.6)
Annotations in grey are not drawn by the app.
click: add point · Backspace: remove last · Enter or ✓: finish · Esc: cancel
B — a form asked for a point
Pick a point for Move to (Alpha 1-1)
click the map · Esc or Cancel: stop picking — the field stays as it was
the requesting field in the form is highlighted; a second request replaces this one with a notice
C — placing a rifleman on a 3-storey building
the ghost is the unit's own symbol at its real footprint —
no big sphere (§2.6); the level shows only when a
click: place · PgUp / PgDn: level · drag: heading · Esc: done
airborne · 300 m over the ground · 150 m/s
a Mobility = Air type is placed in the air (SpawnHeight.AboveLevel);
the drop line shows where it is over the ground
click: place airborne · Shift-click: on the ground · Esc: done
